blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – Former Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) interim chief minister Ahod “Al Haj Murad” Ebrahim has vowed to continue advancing genuine reforms, moral governance, peace, and meaningful development for the Bangsamoro people. Ebrahim, chair of the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF), and MP Mohagher Iqbal, MILF vice chairman, failed to get an elected position in the parliament during its inaugural session on Oct. 30. Ebrahim, president of the United Bangsamoro Justice Party (UBJP), the MILF’s political party, was nominated to be the chief minister of the 80-member first regular parliament but lost to his former military chief, […]...
